_about: Where a search term is found in one paragraph's text (issue #2775). Each match is [start, end): JS string indices (UTF-16 code units) into the original text, end exclusive. Case is folded one code point at a time to its simple lowercase (U+0130 to i, not i + U+0307), matches do not overlap, the term is trimmed, and text is not Unicode-normalized. The host (manuscript.Service.Search, search_test.go) and the mock (manuscriptSearchMock.ts, manuscriptSearchMock.test.ts) both read this file. termMax (UTF-16 units, after trimming), its refusal and matchesMax (the matches one result sends) are the two sides' caps. Hand-written: add a case when a real text is found in the wrong place.
termTooLong: the search term is longer than 500 characters
